name: Chipotle Copycat Chicken
desc: Adobo-marinated chicken thighs seared hard and chopped, burrito bowl style

ingredients.raw: ½ medium red onion, coarsely chopped
One 7oz can of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce or (2 tablespoons adobo sauce and 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder (or 1 oz dried ancho chiles, soaked))
2 tablespoons olive oil or rice bran oil, plus more for cooking
ingredients.item: olive oil or rice bran oil

ingredients.raw: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Make the Marinade: In a blender or food processor, combine red onion, garlic, adobo sauce, ancho chile powder, olive oil, cumin, oregano, 1 teaspoon salt, and ½ teaspoon pepper. Blend until smooth. Pour into a measuring cup and add water to reach 1 cup.
Marinate the Chicken: Place chicken in a large freezer bag. Pour in the marinade, seal, and mash to coat evenly. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight.

Stovetop Method: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken, turning occasionally, until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest under foil for 10 minutes, then chop and season with salt.

Grill Method: Preheat grill to medium-high. Brush with oil. Grill chicken in batches, turning occasionally, until caramelized and 165°F, about 10-15 minutes. Rest under foil for 10 minutes, then chop and season with salt.

Oven Method (best for white meat): Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking dish with oil or spray and arrange chicken in a single layer. Cover completely with parchment paper. Bake 30-40 minutes, until 165°F. Rest under foil for 10 minutes, then chop and season with salt.
